sections.title: Drift is silent
body: A hotfix in the console, a manual index, a column renamed by a script that never got committed: the live database slowly stops matching the design. Nobody notices until a migration fails or a query returns the wrong thing.
sections.caption: Console hotfixes and manual tweaks pile up uncommitted.

sections.title: dbd diff
body: dbd diff is read-only. It reports the complete difference between the live database and the design: columns, keys, constraints, indexes, comments, enums and materialized view drift. With --exit-code it fails the build when they differ.

code.text: dbd diff --exit-code   # non-zero when the live DB has drifted

sections.caption: dbd diff lists every difference, read-only.

sections.title: In CI and before every release
body: Run it against staging on every pull request and against production before a release. Drift becomes a red check with a readable report, not an incident.
points: Covers indexes, comments and enums too
One flag to gate a pipeline
sections.caption: Drift fails the build with a red check.

sections.title: Trust, but diff
body: When assistants touch databases, a mechanical check between intent and reality is the cheapest safety net you can buy.
sections.caption: The live database quietly drifts from the design.
